REM XVGEXCEL.CMD
REM
REM THIS IS THE CODE FOR XVGEXCEL.CMD
REM PLACED HERE IN CASE THE ORIGINAL COMMAND FILE GETS DELETED
REM BY ACCIDENT - JAK
REM
ECHO OFF
CLS
REM
REM %1 CONTAINS WHAT FUNCTION THIS PROGRAM SHOULD PERFORM 
REM 
REM %2 is the drive where the downloaded are placed
REM 
REM %3 is the path of the downloaded files
REM 
REM %4 CONTAINS THE PATH WITHOUT A "\" AT THE END SO I CAN CREATE A DIRECTORY IF NEEDED
REM
REM %5 will contain the name of the prefix of this particular download 
REM this will allow all information to be downloaded into the same directory 
REM 
REM %6 is the extension of the downloaded files
REM
REM %7 is the prefix of the new file
REM 
REM %8 is the variable that is sent in from the calling program
REM It contains the name of the file to append all information into
REM and this is the name that EXCEL will get called with 
REM 
REM %9 contain the suffix of the new file
REM
REM CHECK FOR DIRECTORY EXISTENCE, CREATE WORK DIR IF NOT FOUND
REM 
IF "%1" == "INIT" GOTO CHECK
GOTO CPYFILE
:CHECK
DIR %2%3
IF NOT ERRORLEVEL 1 GOTO CLEAN
MD %2%4
:CLEAN
REM CLEAN UP ANY OLD FILES WITH SAME PREFIX - IN CASE THE LAST DOWNLOAD ABENDED 
DEL %2%3%5*.*
GOTO END
:CPYFILE
REM 
REM This copy function appends all downloaded files with a givin PREFIX and EXTENSION
REM into a specified file 
REM
COPY %2%3%5*%6 %2%3%7%8%9
REM
REM Clean up directory so next download will have clean data
DEL %2%3%5*%6
REM
REM Execute Excel with newly built file
REM - could probably spin off a new thread here so we can return to VisualGen GUI
REM
X:\MSOFFICE\EXCEL.EXE %2%3%7%8%9
REM
REM clean up imported file - If they want to save the import they will can to 
REM save the spreadsheet in EXCEL format in their own Directory 
REM
DEL %2%3%7%8%9
REM
REM
:END
